About

Full Stack Engineer (MERN) with 4+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications and GenAI-powered platforms — from pixel-perfect React UIs to robust Node.js/Express APIs and MongoDB data layers.

Currently engineering the Deloitte AI JumpStart platform at Kanini Software Solutions — a production Generative AI no-code/pro-code system with drag-and-drop UI, LLM integration (GPT-4, LLaMA3, Azure OpenAI), and prompt engineering. I own the full stack: React micro-frontends on the frontend, Node.js/Express services on the backend, and MongoDB for data persistence.
